title: SDK Release Playbook Howto
desc: T2 howto for sdk-release-playbook. Step-by-step release commands. See sdk-release-playbook T1 for decision rules.
steps: STEP 1 version alignment: bump csharp/Directory.Build.props base, VERSIONING.md current, CLAUDE.md header to match Core base version; commit all together.
STEP 2 build and tag: dotnet publish the CLI, then git -C PATH tag vX.Y.Z-sdk and git -C PATH push origin main plus the tag.
STEP 3 release: gh release create vX.Y.Z-sdk from the CHANGELOG section.
Parent T1 wkappbot skill read sdk-release-playbook. Pace bypass wkappbot skill read releasing-under-harness-pace-guards.
